title: Unique Paths III
goal: Count paths from the start to the end that visit every non-obstacle cell exactly once.
strategy: Backtracking marks one visited cell at a time. The end accepts a path only when it is the final unvisited cell; undo each choice so alternate paths can reuse the cell in a different search branch.
